summary: UniFirst Corp filed an 8-K reporting shareholder approval of its acquisition by Cintas Corp via a two-step merger. At a June 11, 2026 special meeting, shareholders voted overwhelmingly in favor: 47,458,203 for, 10,251 against, 17,219 abstain, no broker non-votes. The deal, announced March 10, 2026, involves Merger Sub Inc. merging into UniFirst, then UniFirst merging into Merger Sub LLC, making it a wholly owned Cintas subsidiary. No per-share price or premium is stated; the board recommended the transaction. Watch for regulatory clearance and closing conditions; risk-arb spread reflects deal certainty post-shareholder vote.
